# Environments

Panoramas of light for the 3D view, halved to 512 x 256, scaled so the most light they cast
on a surface is 1, and stored as lossless JPEG XL images by `tools/env/make_env.py`: the four
channels are a Radiance RGBE pixel, and the decode is exact.
Each is from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), released under CC0 (public domain).

| File | Panorama | Authors |
|---|---|---|
| studio.jxl | [Studio Small 09](https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_09) | Sergej Majboroda |
| sunrise.jxl | [Spruit Sunrise](https://polyhaven.com/a/spruit_sunrise) | Greg Zaal |
| beach.jxl | [Spiaggia di Mondello](https://polyhaven.com/a/spiaggia_di_mondello) | Andreas Mischok |
| coast.jxl | [White Cliff Top](https://polyhaven.com/a/white_cliff_top) | Greg Zaal, Rico Cilliers |

| industrial.jxl | [Empty Warehouse 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/empty_warehouse_01) | Sergej Majboroda |
